bots.name: Variance Explainer
bots.tagline: Computes the volume / price / GTN bridge and writes commentary grounded only in those numbers.

steps.label: Volume / price / GTN bridge by therapy area × region
steps.sql:
SELECT therapy_area, region,
  (act_units - bud_units) * bud_net_price AS volume_eff,
  (act_net_price - bud_net_price) * act_units AS price_eff,
  gtn_eff, fx_eff
FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_VPG_BRIDGE WHERE period BETWEEN '2026-07' AND '2026-09';
steps.result: Q3 Total Revenue USD 16.2B (+7% CER) · largest driver: Oncology US volume

steps.label: Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ USD 50M)
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.VPG_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e7 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
steps.result: 5 drivers — Oncology volume, Farxiga LoE, Part D GTN, Rare Disease, FX

steps.label: AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
steps.result: Commentary drafted (212 words) · numeric check: 12/12 figures match bridge

steps.label: Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
Draft commentary to Close Control + dashboard
steps.result: Draft published (badge: Written by Variance Explainer)

guardrails.label: Grounding
guardrails.rule: Every figure in the text must exist in the bridge result

guardrails.label: Materiality
guardrails.rule: Only drivers above threshold are explained

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_VARIANCE_EXPLAINER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  AFTER SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 2}'
AS
  CALL SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('variance-explainer');

-- step 1 · Close Sentinel succeeded
-- Task graph: AFTER SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_CLOSE_SENTINEL
-- step 2 · Volume / price / GTN bridge by therapy area × region
SELECT therapy_area, region,
  (act_units - bud_units) * bud_net_price AS volume_eff,
  (act_net_price - bud_net_price) * act_units AS price_eff,
  gtn_eff, fx_eff
FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_VPG_BRIDGE WHERE period BETWEEN '2026-07' AND '2026-09';
-- step 3 · Rank top 5 drivers (|effect| ≥ USD 50M)
SELECT * FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.VPG_BRIDGE_RESULT WHERE ABS(effect) >= 5e7 QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ABS(effect) DESC) <= 5;
-- step 4 · AI_COMPLETE commentary (grounded in step 3 only)
SELECT AI_COMPLETE('claude-sonnet-4-5',
  'Write Group Controller commentary using ONLY these figures: ' || OBJECT_CONSTRUCT(*)::STRING)
FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.VPG_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5;
-- step 5 · Guardrail: every number in text exists in bridge
SELECT SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.FN_NUMBERS_GROUNDED(:commentary, 'VPG_BRIDGE_RESULT_TOP5');
-- step 6 · Draft commentary to Close Control + dashboard
INSERT INTO SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.REPORT_NARRATIVE_LOG (page, text, source) VALUES ('close-control', :commentary, 'SNOWBOT:variance-explainer');

Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox

steps.sql: INSERT INTO SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_COST_CENTER SELECT ... FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

bots.ddl:
-- Deployable spec (not executed in demo mode)
CREATE OR REPLACE TASK SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.T_GL_MAPPER
  WAREHOUSE = SDP_BOT_WH
  SCHEDULE = 'USING CRON 0 6 * * * Europe/London'
  CONFIG = '{"autonomy": 3}'
AS
  CALL SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.SP_RUN_BOT('gl-mapper');

-- step 1 · Unmapped cost centres detected
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_COST_CENTRES WHERE source = 'ALEXION_ERP';
-- step 2 · AI_CLASSIFY against group cost-centre hierarchy
SELECT cc_code, AI_CLASSIFY(cc_name || ' ' || sample_postings,
  (SELECT ARRAY_AGG(label) FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.DIM_COST_CENTER WHERE active)) AS mapping
FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.V_UNMAPPED_COST_CENTRES;
-- step 3 · Guardrail: confidence ≥ 0.92 auto-apply, rest to Inbox
SELECT * FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence < 0.92;
-- step 4 · Apply mappings + re-run IC match
INSERT INTO SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.PUBLIC.MAP_COST_CENTER SELECT ... FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.GL_MAP_PROPOSALS WHERE confidence >= 0.92;

steps.label: Accrual vs claims by brand × payer programme
steps.sql: SELECT brand, programme, accrued, claimed, claimed - accrued AS gap FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_GTN_ACCRUAL_VS_CLAIMS WHERE period BETWEEN '2026-07' AND '2026-09';
steps.result: Part D +4.1% above accrual on oncology brands · 340B +3.8% on primary care

steps.label: Guardrail: gap > 2% or > USD 10M → true-up proposal
steps.sql: SELECT * FROM SDP_ASTRAZENECA_TEASER.SNOWBOTS.V_GTN_ACCRUAL_VS_CLAIMS WHERE ABS(gap) > GREATEST(0.02 * accrued, 1e7);
